controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by Kepler-452; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of this planet exists (it has never been resolved: only its transit depth and orbit are measured; see the investigation ledger). The gray marks an unresolved surface; the lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. Its reality as a planet is disputed: Mullally et al. (2018) and Burke et al. (2019) find it cannot be statistically validated; Robnik & Seljak (2025) support its validation. The gray takes the colour of kepler-452's light, as its colour lens measures it.
